name: feature
summary: New or changed behaviour, decided first, built to a gate, hardened before it ships.

steps.title: Record the decision if this adds a port, an adapter, or a dependency
steps.done_when: Either an ADR covers this change, or the change adds no port, adapter or dependency.

steps.title: Write the gate before the code, and not derived from it
steps.run: hexa loop gate '<command that must exit 0 when the feature works>'
steps.done_when: The command is recorded and it fails today. A gate generated from the implementation is the mirror test in a new hat.

steps.title: Diverge, red-team, and build to the gate
Run the adversarial pass over what was built
steps.done_when: Every finding is verified or dismissed, and each fix held the gate.

steps.title: Grade the shape you leave behind
steps.done_when: The grade is at or above where it was before you started.
